259213.name: Chabad of Newton Centre
259213.note: Lubavitch.com, 26 Jan 2005 ('New Chabad Centers in Mass.'): Rabbi Yehuda Krinsky 'has announced the opening of two new Chabad-Lubavitch centers in the Boston area': Newton Center, directed by Rabbi and Mrs. Moshe Lieberman. Its chabad.org listing went up in Feb 2005.

259795.name: Coolidge Corner Chabad Chai Center
259795.note: Lubavitch.com, 26 Jan 2005 ('New Chabad Centers in Mass.'): Rabbi Yehuda Krinsky 'has announced the opening of two new Chabad-Lubavitch centers in the Boston area': Coolidge Corner in Brookline, directed by Rabbi and Mrs. Mayshe Schwartz. Its chabad.org listing went up in Feb 2005.

118574.name: Chabad Serving Tufts University
118574.note: The Tufts Daily, Dec 2003: 'The Chabad House arrived on campus last fall' (fall 2002), with Rabbi Tzvi Backman, 'who heads the Chabad House'. The Tufts Daily (Oct 2013): the Backmans started it after a recommendation from Rabbi Hirschy Zarchi of Harvard's Chabad. Medium: one source, and 'last fall' is relative. (Tufts's student government recognized Chabad in May 2005, the Forward reported.)

5105754.name: Chabad of Watertown
5105754.note: CrownHeights.info, 26 Aug 2021: Rabbi Dovid Zaltzman, 'a new Shliach to Watertown, MA'. Its chabad.org listing's publication date is 8 Apr 2025, but its number (5105754) is from the same series as listings made in spring 2021 (5103013, North Seattle, went up 25 Apr 2021), so it was first made then.

6539621.name: Chabad West Serving Boston University
6539621.note: CrownHeights.info, 4 Dec 2024, on seed funding for 'one hundred new Chabad centers in underserved areas', shows 'Rabbi Yisroel and Zelda Posner at Chabad West Serving Boston University'. Its chabad.org listing went up 5 Aug 2024.
